name: robots/darshmenon__quadruped-robotics-stack
title: Unitree Go2 MuJoCo parkour scene
intro: Unitree Go2 MuJoCo parkour scene, adapted from darshmenon/quadruped-robotics-stack. It reads `time_ms`, `qpos`, `qvel`, `ctrl` and 4 more; runs `step` and `reset`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
